featured_reviews.name: Anthony Stephen Mendes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hosted our event here with 55 people turning up over 6 hours. The team helped us understand the booking process & their on ground staff was superb in handling requests and ensuring everyone had fun.

The space is comfortable and large, it has three tables you can use for pop-ups/stalls at an event.

The pricing on an hourly rate is excellent value for money.

Ours was a meetup for Pokemon, Hot Wheels and Beyblade fans in Mumbai.

Workbay is situated on SV Road and is therefore easy to access with public transport.

Our team at Uhtend had zero issues hosting the event; lighting was great for photos too.

I would recommend Workbay for your events if you’re hosting meetups, flea markets, etc.

The elevator leading to the workspace on the third floor is big which makes it easy to carry equipment or merchandise.

Other features:

2 large tables, 1 medium sized table and 1 long table. The latter has a long bench on both sides.

Separate washroom for men & women.

Fridge: in case you need to cool beverages, recommend confirming with the coworking space.

I recommend getting an appointment to visit the space & discuss details; this will help their team to ensure your event goes smoothly.

Attaching photos for reference of space size.

featured_reviews.review_text:
WeWork Bandra is one of the best coworking spaces in Mumbai, offering a perfect blend of productivity and vibrant energy. The atmosphere is dynamic yet relaxed, making it an ideal place for professionals, startups, and freelancers.

The crowd here is fantastic—young, energetic, and diverse, creating a collaborative and inspiring work environment. The space itself is well-designed, with modern interiors, comfortable seating, and plenty of natural light. Whether you're working solo or in a team, there are ample options, from private cabins to open desks and lounge areas.

The community vibe is strong, with regular networking events, workshops, and social gatherings that make working here more than just about business. Plus, the amenities—great coffee, high-speed WiFi, and helpful staff—add to the overall experience.

If you're looking for a coworking space in Bandra with good vibes, a great crowd, and a motivating atmosphere, WeWork Bandra is a top choice.

featured_reviews.name: Katherine Abraham
featured_reviews.review_text: I was at the 603 Co working space for a week since my boss was down in India. I traveled from Pune and was in two minds of this was a good option Until I reached the place. 603 has a very artistically done up reception area that's immediately inviting and warm. Billing was quick and we were on our way to our desk. The Elaichi tea is heaven! I didn't miss a day! They allow you to dine at your desk which is rather good for people who like to nibble away as they work. The place is clean and Tejas and her staff is exceptionally friendly. The boy at the counter ensured I got my free print-outs on time. No fuss anywhere and it's a lively environment to work in (even an introvert like me enjoyed the positive vibe!) All in all the 603 is a delightful space to visit and work if you're in Khar, Mumbai. I'll hope to return soon!

featured_reviews.name: Dan Daley
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a positive experience spending a week at the 603 Khar location whilst working remotely in Mumbai. The space is on the 5th floor of a modern office block, right next to Khar station. On my first day I was greeted at the reception area and given an intro to the coworking areas. This includes a tidy shared open plan room with wood tables, high speed internet and a pantry with basic amenities such as coffee / tea and a kitchen area for food prep. It was a good experience working there and I would recommend it as an affordable option for your coworking needs.

featured_reviews.review_text: The conference room is good. So is the service. However, there was a peculiar issue. You are unable to make an online payment as while booking, it says make payment at site after meeting. They don't send you a proper GST invoice. But they ask you to make payment before using the conference room, once you reach the location. That again is not an issue. Strangely, the issue is that they do not accept payment by cards but only thru NEFT or UPI. Since these are Corporate bookings, one needs to take care of this to avoid any embarrassment in front of guests.

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Todkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Good service, Staff is great in terms of understanding and clear communication. Worth the waiting hours if you want the best service

featured_reviews.name: abdul qadir haji
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing showroom with stunning cars , good staff.

featured_reviews.name: Adesh Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: I am currently a client at Regus BKC office. Regus Admin staff has pathetic approach and services (deserves 0 stars). They are very unprofessional. Confusing accounting statments and no proper support to resolve the issues and post that even after paying they will keep charging late payment fees. Very rude staff.

featured_reviews.name: RASIK HULSOGI
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the finest buildings in BKC. Well maintained and great ambience. Hassle free entry with proper security check. Elevators available in plenty. Great place for an office or business.

featured_reviews.name: Kaeton Maisrya
featured_reviews.review_text: I want to give minus rating but that is not possible, I had a very unpleasant experience at Regus. they do not corporate at anything and treat their customer like beggars. They are very rude and refuse in everything. they refused us to use the common room for calls, refused for parking and advising us to use the mall for parking. they even refused to use the cafeteria as we had a one day meeting room booking. I will not at all recommend them for anything, they are useless and rude, they charge for each and everything other then breathing in their premises.
